name: team-classic

frames.best_why: All four member cards are sharp, with the hovered card's green ring and emoji badge shown.

tagline: Four portrait cards on pink, each with a coloured ring on hover.
summary: A pink team page with a script-like heading and four member cards: square photos, names, green role labels and three small social icons each.
appearance: A pale pink page with a centred heading and two lines of tiny grey copy. Four cards show a rounded square portrait with a soft shadow, a bold name, a small green uppercase role and three grey social icons in a row.
behaviour: Hovering a card adds a coloured ring around the photo and pops a small emoji badge into the top corner. The social icons darken on hover.
demo_content: Candice Wu, Demi Wilkinson, Drew Cano and Natali Craig with their roles.
search_phrases: team page on a pink background
four member cards with photos and socials
colour ring around portrait on hover
script heading for meet the team
small social icons under each name
soft pink team section for a startup
use_when: A small startup team page wants a soft, friendly roster with social links.
avoid_when: Each photo needs a square crop, and the four members are hardcoded in the JSX.
customise: Names, roles, photos, ring colours and emojis are literal objects in the file; spacing and the pink background are classes.
weight_why: Four small portraits and a scroll reveal; hover effects are CSS.

a11y.note: Social icon links have no text or aria-label, so they read as unnamed links.

issues: Social icon links carry no accessible names.
The intro paragraph is filler copy that says nothing about the team.
polish_why: Pleasant pink palette and clean portraits; filler copy and bare social icons hold it back.
